stocks.impact_theory: US 50% tariffs on Canadian steel imports shift demand to domestic producers like Nucor. Economic implications include higher US steel prices boosting margins. (2) Like rerouting traffic to local shops when imports are blocked.

news_impact_analysis.reasoning: Tariffs directly favor domestic steel; X sentiment overwhelmingly positive with steel stocks trending; volume surge confirms buying interest.

potential_profit_risks.short_position: Avoid shorts; limited downside unless tariffs reversed.
potential_profit_risks.key_risks: Tariff rollback negotiations, rising input costs, global oversupply.

stocks.justification: Direct causal link from policy announcement, strong immediate price action and sentiment alignment.
